_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: asset_taken
data.sql: CREATE INDEX asset_taken ON asset (taken_utc DESC, id);

data.name: album_item_order
data.sql: CREATE INDEX album_item_order ON album_item (album_id, sort_key);

data.name: local_asset_path
data.sql: CREATE INDEX local_asset_path ON local_asset (volume, path);

data.name: local_asset_file
data.sql: CREATE INDEX local_asset_file ON local_asset (volume, file_id);

data.name: local_asset_pending
data.sql: CREATE INDEX local_asset_pending ON local_asset (COALESCE(taken, mtime) DESC, id DESC) WHERE extracted IS NULL;

data.name: timeline_item
data.sql: CREATE VIEW timeline_item AS SELECT id, source, volume, source_id, path, size, mtime, mime, COALESCE(added, 0) AS added, CAST(COALESCE(strftime('%Y%m%d', taken_local), strftime('%Y%m%d', COALESCE(taken, mtime) / 1000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS day, COALESCE(taken_utc, taken, mtime) AS sort_key FROM local_asset WHERE state = 'present' AND trashed = 0

data.name: local_asset_timeline
data.sql:
CREATE INDEX local_asset_timeline ON local_asset (
  CAST(COALESCE(strftime('%Y%m%d', taken_local), strftime('%Y%m%d', COALESCE(taken, mtime) / 1000, 'unixepoch'))
    AS INTEGER) DESC,
  COALESCE(taken_utc, taken, mtime) DESC, id DESC) WHERE state = 'present' AND trashed = 0;

data.name: local_asset_added
data.sql: CREATE INDEX local_asset_added ON local_asset (COALESCE(added, 0) DESC, id DESC) WHERE state = 'present' AND trashed = 0;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "privacy" TEXT NOT NULL, "access" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_uri" TEXT, "is_upload_target" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "library_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "original_filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_ref" TEXT, "content_hash" BLOB, "media_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "facets" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "taken_local" TEXT, "tz_offset_min" INTEGER, "tz_name" TEXT, "taken_utc" INTEGER, "time_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "time_confidence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "time_precision" TEXT, "tz_assumed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lat" REAL, "lon" REAL, "alt" REAL, "accuracy_m" REAL, "location_source" TEXT, "place_id" BLOB, "width" INTEGER, "height" INTEGER, "orientation" INTEGER, "duration_ms" INTEGER, "file_size_total" INTEGER, "make" TEXT, "model" TEXT, "lens" TEXT, "title" TEXT, "description" TEXT, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color_label" TEXT, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "trashed_at" INTEGER, "stack_id" BLOB, "stack_order" INTEGER, "current_version_id" BLOB, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX asset_taken ON asset (taken_utc DESC, id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_user_state" ("asset_id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden_from_memories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_viewed_at" INTEGER, "playback_position_ms" INTEGER, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_file" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "asset_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_hash" BLOB, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX asset_file_asset ON asset_file (asset_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_version" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "asset_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "parent_id" BLOB, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT, "recipe" BLOB, "render_file_id" BLOB, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stack" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover_asset_id" BLOB, "review_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unreviewed', "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album_folder" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "parent_id" BLOB, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "folder_id" BLOB, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT, "cover_asset_id" BLOB, "sort_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom', "layout" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'grid', "privacy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album_item" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "album_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" BLOB, "anchor_asset_id" BLOB, "payload" TEXT, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX album_item_order ON album_item (album_id, sort_key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "parent_id" BLOB, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT, "is_album" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_tag" ("asset_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "tag_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "confidence" REAL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "txid" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(asset_id, tag_id)) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX asset_tag_tag ON asset_tag (tag_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "owner_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'human', "name" TEXT, "birth_date" TEXT, "cover_face_id" BLOB, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "merged_into" BLOB, "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "face" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "asset_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "bbox" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" REAL, "person_id" BLOB, "assignment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "txid" INTEGER) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX face_person ON face (person_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_asset" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" TEXT, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mtime" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_hash" BLOB, "asset_id" BLOB, "path" TEXT, "file_id" TEXT, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'present', "name" TEXT, "bucket_id" TEXT, "bucket_name" TEXT, "mime" TEXT, "taken" INTEGER, "width" INTEGER, "height" INTEGER, "orientation" INTEGER, "duration_ms" INTEGER, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "trashed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "expires" INTEGER, "extracted" INTEGER, "taken_local" TEXT, "tz_offset_min" INTEGER, "taken_utc" INTEGER, "time_source" TEXT, "time_confidence" INTEGER, "time_precision" TEXT, "lat" REAL, "lon" REAL, "make" TEXT, "model" TEXT, "facets" TEXT, "cloud_id" TEXT, "burst_id" TEXT, "edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "added" INTEGER, UNIQUE(source, volume, source_id)) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX local_asset_path ON local_asset (volume, path)
CREATE INDEX local_asset_file ON local_asset (volume, file_id)
CREATE INDEX local_asset_pending ON local_asset (COALESCE(taken, mtime) DESC, id DESC) WHERE extracted IS NULL

CREATE VIEW timeline_item AS SELECT id, source, volume, source_id, path, size, mtime, mime, COALESCE(added, 0) AS added, CAST(COALESCE(strftime('%Y%m%d', taken_local), strftime('%Y%m%d', COALESCE(taken, mtime) / 1000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS day, COALESCE(taken_utc, taken, mtime) AS sort_key FROM local_asset WHERE state = 'present' AND trashed = 0

CREATE INDEX local_asset_timeline ON local_asset (CAST(COALESCE(strftime('%Y%m%d', taken_local), strftime('%Y%m%d', COALESCE(taken, mtime) / 1000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) DESC, COALESCE(taken_utc, taken, mtime) DESC, id DESC) WHERE state = 'present' AND trashed = 0
CREATE INDEX local_asset_added ON local_asset (COALESCE(added, 0) DESC, id DESC) WHERE state = 'present' AND trashed = 0
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_source" ("root" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online', "checkpoint" TEXT) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "volume_cursor" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume" TEXT NOT NULL, "install_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "root" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(source, volume)) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_state" ("local_asset_id" BLOB NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT, "retry_at" INTEGER, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "mutation_id" BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "mutation" BLOB NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "retry_at" INTEGER, "error" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursor" ("stream" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "cursor" BLOB NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ext_journal_cursor" ("journal" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "merged" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT;
